prompt_en: Create a documentary-style night photograph inside a nearly empty self-service laundromat. An unmistakably adult woman, with visible facial proportions, dark eyes, and a short straight dark bob with loose wispy bangs guided by the attached portrait, kneels on a black rubber floor mat in front of an open front-loading washer. Her left shin rests on the mat and her right foot is planted on the tile, leaving room for her torso to lean toward the drum. Her right forearm crosses the clear space between her knee and the drum. With her right thumb and forefinger she lifts one corner of a damp cobalt-blue scarf just outside the circular drum opening; the fabric sags under its own weight and clear droplets cling to its folded lower edge. Her left palm braces on the stationary steel machine rim, separate from the open glass door swinging toward the camera. She looks down at the cloth, her face visible in three-quarter view beneath the fringe. The opened drum is still, with water beads on the grey gasket and a small damp crescent on the metal threshold. Cool overhead strip lighting falls over the tiled aisle, while a warm street sign across the front window reflects softly along the machine's curved chrome trim. A camera angle just above the washer opening keeps her full face, both hands, the scarf, rim, open door, and floor support readable together. Preserve fine fabric weave, natural skin texture, slight optical falloff toward the repeating machines, and physically plausible glass reflections. Place her and the washer in the left two-thirds of the frame, with a row of idle machines receding through the right third. A faint crescent of fingertip polish lies on the brushed steel rim immediately beside her bracing left palm; the metal grain continues through the trace while adjacent steel retains its cooler highlight.
